## Visibility Recommendation: PUBLIC

### Strategic Tradeoff Analysis

| Metric | PUBLIC Repository | PRIVATE Repository |
|---|---|---|
| **Portfolio Showcase Value** | **HIGH**: Direct evidence of AI system architecture, Agent Skills standards, Playwright testing, and design craft. | **ZERO**: Invisible to recruiters, hiring managers, and GitHub visitors. |
| **Pi Package Portability** | **HIGH**: Can be installed anywhere via `pi install git:github.com/kerwinarlan/frontend-design-intelligence`. | **MEDIUM**: Requires SSH key / GitHub PAT authentication on every machine. |
| **Security & Compliance Risk** | **ZERO**: Contains zero API keys, zero secrets, zero proprietary assets, and strictly compliant MIT licensing. | **ZERO**: No extra protection needed as no sensitive data exists. |

### Final Recommendation
Publish as a **PUBLIC** repository on GitHub. It serves as a flagship demonstration of AI coding agent harness design, progressive disclosure architecture, and modern web motion engineering.
